title: Show the critical path and slack on the index screen
goal: The coordinator's own screen lists the critical path and each step's slack, as text
acceptance: The screen at http://127.0.0.1:7380/ has a "Critical path" section: the chain in order with hours, then a table of every open step with its lane, remaining hours and slack, each linked to its file at the commit; problems listed under it
Text only, no chart; renders from the cache at each request like the other sections; a test over the rendered page for a chain with slack and for an empty graph
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One more section on the existing live screen, rendered from the same function; the drawn graph is NERV's, not this screen's. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
